```{r dash-scorecard, echo=FALSE, results='asis'}
library(dplyr)
library(htmltools)

# ============================================================
# IDENTIFY CURRENT AND BASELINE RUNS
# ============================================================

run_summary <- raw_data %>%
  mutate(
    is_pass = tolower(trimws(as.character(success))) %in%
      c("true", "yes", "1")
  ) %>%
  group_by(run_id) %>%
  summarise(
    sequence_num = first(sequence_num),
    users = n_distinct(user_index, na.rm = TRUE),
    tx_count = n(),
    pass_count = sum(is_pass, na.rm = TRUE),
    duration_secs = as.numeric(
      difftime(
        max(timestamp, na.rm = TRUE),
        min(timestamp, na.rm = TRUE),
        units = "secs"
      )
    ),
    throughput = round(pass_count / duration_secs, 2),
    error_rate = round(
      sum(
        !tolower(trimws(as.character(success))) %in% c("true", "yes", "1"),
        na.rm = TRUE
      ) / tx_count * 100,
      2
    ),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

current <- run_summary %>%
  filter(sequence_num == max(sequence_num))

baseline <- run_summary %>%
  filter(sequence_num == min(sequence_num))

current_run_id  <- current$run_id[1]
baseline_run_id <- baseline$run_id[1]

# ============================================================
# RT SLA PASS RATE
# ============================================================

current_rt <- get_run_rt_sla(current_run_id)
baseline_rt <- get_run_rt_sla(baseline_run_id)

current_rt_pass_rate <- NA
baseline_rt_pass_rate <- NA

if (!is.null(current_rt) &&
    current_rt$total_labels > 0) {

  current_rt_pass_rate <- round(
    (current_rt$passed_count /
       current_rt$total_labels) * 100,
    1
  )
}

if (!is.null(baseline_rt) &&
    baseline_rt$total_labels > 0) {

  baseline_rt_pass_rate <- round(
    (baseline_rt$passed_count /
       baseline_rt$total_labels) * 100,
    1
  )
}

# ============================================================
# RESPONSE TIME
# ============================================================

current_p95 <- raw_data %>%
  filter(run_id == current_run_id) %>%
  summarise(
    v = round(
      quantile(elapsed, 0.95, na.rm = TRUE),
      0
    )
  ) %>%
  pull(v)

baseline_p95 <- raw_data %>%
  filter(run_id == baseline_run_id) %>%
  summarise(
    v = round(
      quantile(elapsed, 0.95, na.rm = TRUE),
      0
    )
  ) %>%
  pull(v)

# ============================================================
# DELTA HELPER
# ============================================================

delta_text <- function(current,
                       baseline,
                       lower_is_better = FALSE) {

  if (is.na(current) || is.na(baseline)) {
    return("—")
  }

  if (baseline == 0) {

    if (current == 0) {
      return("▬ 0%")
    }

    return(
      "<span class='status-fail'>New Errors</span>"
    )
  }

  delta <- round(
    ((current - baseline) / baseline) * 100,
    1
  )

  if (delta == 0) {
    return("▬ 0.00%")
  }

  if (lower_is_better) {

    if (delta < 0) {

      return(
        sprintf(
          "<span class='status-pass'>▼ %.1f%%</span>",
          abs(delta)
        )
      )
    }

    return(
      sprintf(
        "<span class='status-fail'>▲ %.1f%%</span>",
        delta
      )
    )
  }

  if (delta > 0) {

    return(
      sprintf(
        "<span class='status-pass'>▲ %.1f%%</span>",
        delta
      )
    )
  }

  sprintf(
    "<span class='status-fail'>▼ %.1f%%</span>",
    abs(delta)
  )
}

# ============================================================
# SCORECARD HTML
# ============================================================

scorecard_html <- sprintf(
'

</tr>

<tr>

</tr>

',

# Users
format(current$users[1], big.mark = ","),
format(baseline$users[1], big.mark = ","),

delta_text(
  current$users[1],
  baseline$users[1]
),

# Transactions
format(current$tx_count[1], big.mark = ","),
format(baseline$tx_count[1], big.mark = ","),

delta_text(
  current$tx_count[1],
  baseline$tx_count[1]
),

# Throughput
current$throughput[1],
baseline$throughput[1],

delta_text(
  current$throughput[1],
  baseline$throughput[1]
),

# Error Rate
current$error_rate[1],
baseline$error_rate[1],

delta_text(
  current$error_rate[1],
  baseline$error_rate[1],
  lower_is_better = TRUE
),

# RT SLA Pass Rate
current_rt_pass_rate,
baseline_rt_pass_rate,

delta_text(
  current_rt_pass_rate,
  baseline_rt_pass_rate
),

# P95
current_p95,
baseline_p95,

delta_text(
  current_p95,
  baseline_p95,
  lower_is_better = TRUE
)

)

HTML(scorecard_html)
```
